brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) capped on all 6 side faces (caps at 30/90/150/210/270/330°) and closed on top with solid cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top). Forms a sealed hex box for electronics.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre installed in slot 0 (port:0#0,0#0) – hex-port-louvre vents closed cell without letting rain in. Props show use: solder reel on top surface, PSU and multimeter staged on bench beside enclosure.

finish.summary: Built minimal 1-cell closed hex enclosure: top cover + 6 side caps, with louvre vent in wall slot for airflow while remaining rain-resistant. House rules capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied; electronics staging props added.
